source: psz-re tools/fieldfix.py -- offline, from the savestate corpus only
answers: psz-godot #584: real generated fields tied to the input that produced them
ON_A_FIRST_FLOOR_THE_SESSION_SEED_IS_THE: 10 of 10 area-A fields have a generation-start LCG state EQUAL to their 16-bit session seed, zero-extended, with ZERO draws in between -- so for a first floor the seed really is the field's seed and #584's question has a clean yes. 0 of 4 area-B fields do, and they cannot: the previous floor's generation already spent draws on the same continuous stream, and their offsets are [205, 209, 223, 456].
THE_SEED_ALONE_DOES_NOT_DETERMINE_A_FIEL: the generator shares ONE continuous LCG with the whole session, so a field is a function of the LCG STATE AT GENERATION START plus the eleven assembled parameters -- and those come from the quest override record, not from the area. The 16-bit session seed is recorded where recoverable, and on a FIRST floor the offset between it and generation start is ZERO: generation_start_state IS the seed, zero-extended. On a later floor the offset is nonzero and per capture (205, 209, 223, 456 here), because the previous floor already spent draws on the same stream. The 55..84 figure this file used to quote was NOT that offset -- it was the distance to the first per-room SEED, which the transcriber writes at the very end and which therefore already contains generation's own cost; over these fixtures that quantity is 48..113 on a first floor. See tools/fieldfix.py --seed-run.
how_to_consume: each fixture's input block is the whole input. Run your generator from generation_start_state with those params and compare `edges` (normalised grid coordinates), `transcription_order` (internal placement index -> output room index) and `grid.goal_xy`. `rooms` is the field as the game transcribed it: cell, room code, rotation, per-direction neighbour and gate, keys, layout index.

generator.grid: 7 wide x 10 tall, cells 0x1C bytes at gen+0xB4, row stride 0xC4
generator.start_cell: (3, 9 - params[9]) -- column 3 of 7, and near the BOTTOM row
generator.there_is_no_fallback_layout: FUN_02081EA8 has no all-or-nothing restart and no canned layout. It grows greedily once (FUN_020821D0), and if it came up short it runs ONE extension attempt (FUN_02082228) and grows again. Nothing is ever thrown away.

not_to_be_confused_with: data/generation_fixtures.json, which is two LIVE breakpoint readings of the drawn target at 0x02081ED4. This file is the field itself, offline, from savestates.
